# Settings and accessibility

One switch turns all sound off, and no one misses anything when it is off.

**Kind:** Foundation

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/styles/SoundSettings.mdx`

## The switch

One setting turns every sound off. It is on by default and kept across visits. Nothing is opt-in, and reduced motion does not mute sound. Sound follows the device's volume.

## Pairing

Every sound pairs with an on-screen change that says the same thing: a Flag, a step checked, a message. Sound is never the only signal, so turning it off loses nothing.

## The student rule

A sound a student can hear is good news only. A concern never plays while a student can hear, and a shared moment, such as a goal reached, plays for both.
